words.enDefinition: Comparing alternatives using items that change between the choices

examples.en: We used differential analysis to compare keeping the shop open with closing on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我们用「差量分析」比较周日营业与歇业两种方案。

examples.en: The differential analysis showed only amounts that differed between the two proposals.
examples.zh: 「差量分析」只列出两个方案中有差异的金额。

collocations: use differential analysis to compare alternatives

words.enDefinition: The difference in revenue expected under two alternative courses of action

examples.en: The extra print run generated differential revenue without changing sales from existing orders.
examples.zh: 额外印刷产生了「差量收入」，原有订单的销售额没有变化。

examples.en: We entered differential revenue before calculating the change in the workshop's income.
examples.zh: 我们先填入「差量收入」，再计算工作室收益的变化。

collocations: compare differential revenue with differential cost

words.enDefinition: The difference in total cost between two decision alternatives

examples.en: The differential cost between the suppliers included packaging as well as the purchase price.
examples.zh: 两家供货商方案的「差量成本」包括包装费，也包括采购价。

examples.en: Our exercise calculated differential cost for two ways of meeting the same order.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中计算了完成同一订单的两种方案之间的「差量成本」。

collocations: compare the differential cost with revenue

words.enDefinition: The change in operating profit from choosing one alternative over another

examples.en: The worksheet showed differential operating income after comparing each option's revenue and relevant costs.
examples.zh: 练习表比较各方案的收入和相关成本后，列出了「差量营业利润」。

examples.en: Our group checked whether differential operating income changed when the setup cost rose.
examples.zh: 我们组核对了准备成本提高时「差量营业利润」是否变化。

words.enDefinition: A cost that does not change between the options being considered

examples.en: We treated unchanged insurance as an irrelevant cost in the weekend opening decision.
examples.zh: 在决定周末是否营业时，我们把金额不变的保险费视为「非相关成本」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the old equipment price was an irrelevant cost.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么旧设备的购入价属于「非相关成本」？

collocations: omit an irrelevant cost from a comparison
treat a cost as an irrelevant cost

words.enDefinition: Money expected to be paid after the decision is made

examples.en: Only one option required a future cash outlay for a new storage cabinet.
examples.zh: 只有一种方案需要为新储物柜产生「未来现金支出」。

examples.en: Our exercise placed the future cash outlay in the month when payment was expected.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中把「未来现金支出」放在预计付款的月份。

collocations: a future cash outlay for equipment

words.enDefinition: A fixed cost tied to a commitment difficult to change quickly

examples.en: The room lease was a committed fixed cost during the decision period in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂讨论的决策期间，房间租约对应的是「约束性固定成本」。

examples.en: Our group treated the annual equipment lease as a committed fixed cost.
examples.zh: 我们组把年度设备租赁费归为「约束性固定成本」。

words.enDefinition: A fixed cost whose budget managers can change by policy decision

examples.en: The annual promotion budget was a discretionary fixed cost in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，年度推广预算是「酌量性固定成本」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the workshop budget counted as a discretionary fixed cost for next term.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了工作坊预算是否属于下学期的「酌量性固定成本」。

collocations: an example of a discretionary fixed cost

words.enDefinition: A fixed cost that will remain under the alternatives being compared

examples.en: The lease payment was an unavoidable fixed cost even if the stall closed early.
examples.zh: 即使提前收摊，租赁款仍是「不可避免的固定成本」。

examples.en: Our worksheet carried the unavoidable fixed cost under both the keep and close options.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表把「不可避免的固定成本」同时列在保留和关闭两种方案下。

words.enDefinition: The span of time over which costs and benefits are compared

examples.en: The relevant time horizon ended before the lease could be renegotiated in our case.
examples.zh: 在案例中，租约可以重新商谈之前，「相关决策期间」就结束了。

examples.en: We agreed on a relevant time horizon before deciding which costs could change.
examples.zh: 我们先确定「相关决策期间」，再判断哪些成本可能变动。

collocations: changes in the relevant time horizon

words.enDefinition: The value of the best alternative use of committed capacity

examples.en: The opportunity cost of capacity came from jobs the workshop would have to turn away.
examples.zh: 「产能机会成本」来自工作室必须婉拒的订单。

examples.en: Our example showed no opportunity cost of capacity while an unused machine remained available.
examples.zh: 范例中还有闲置机器可用，因而没有「产能机会成本」。

collocations: estimate the opportunity cost of capacity
include the opportunity cost of capacity

words.enDefinition: Contribution margin lost when a competing use or sale is forgone

examples.en: The extra batch displaced regular sales, creating foregone contribution in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，追加批次挤掉了常规销量，产生了「放弃的边际贡献」。

examples.en: We compared the foregone contribution with the margin from the alternative work.
examples.zh: 我们对照了「放弃的边际贡献」与替代业务带来的边际贡献。

words.enDefinition: Additional preparation cost caused by taking on another batch or job

examples.en: The short run required an incremental setup cost because the print settings had changed.
examples.zh: 短批次的打印设置变了，因此需要一笔「增量准备成本」。

examples.en: Our table included an incremental setup cost for changing tools before the extra order.
examples.zh: 我们的表把追加订单前换工具的开支列为「增量准备成本」。

collocations: an incremental setup cost per batch

words.enDefinition: A preparation fee incurred once rather than for every unit

examples.en: The supplier put a one-time setup charge beside the price per printed bag.
examples.zh: 供应商在印花包单价旁另列了「一次性准备费」。

examples.en: The case kept the one-time setup charge constant as order volume increased.
examples.zh: 案例里，订单量增加时，「一次性准备费」保持不变。

words.enDefinition: Additional delivery cost caused by choosing a particular option

examples.en: The order required a separate van, adding an incremental shipping cost to the estimate.
examples.zh: 这单要单独派一辆货车，因此估算中增加了「增量运费」。

examples.en: Our table set the incremental shipping cost to zero when both jobs shared delivery.
examples.zh: 两批货合并配送时，我们在表里把「增量运费」设为零。

collocations: an incremental shipping cost per shipment

words.enDefinition: Payroll spending that would end if a specific activity stopped

examples.en: The tutor listed temporary shifts under avoidable payroll cost for the closure decision.
examples.zh: 导师在关闭决定的练习中，把临时班次列为「可节省的薪资成本」。

examples.en: We separated the avoidable payroll cost from salaries the workshop would continue paying.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「可节省的薪资成本」与工作室仍会支付的工资。

words.enDefinition: The amount currently needed to replace materials or other resources

examples.en: The class used current replacement cost for stock that would otherwise be replenished.
examples.zh: 对于原本就会补进的存货，全班采用了「当前重置成本」。

examples.en: We compared current replacement cost with the price originally paid for the wood.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「当前重置成本」与当初买木材的价格。

collocations: price materials at current replacement cost

words.enDefinition: Production inputs already held when a decision is being evaluated

examples.en: The worksheet asked whether the materials in stock could be sold instead of used.
examples.zh: 练习表问，现有的「在库材料」是否也可以卖掉。

examples.en: We checked the materials in stock before estimating the additional cash needed.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「在库材料」，再估算所需的额外现金。

collocations: value materials in stock for a decision

words.enDefinition: Cash received from selling unusable materials or assets as scrap

examples.en: The class counted the lost scrap proceeds when the old material was reused.
examples.zh: 旧材料被拿来再用时，全班计入了因此放弃的「材料报废变卖收入」。

examples.en: Our table listed scrap proceeds beside the unused steel in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们的表在闲置钢材旁列出了「材料报废变卖收入」。

words.enDefinition: The benefit obtainable by shifting an existing resource to another use

examples.en: The scenario calculated redeployment value for a machine that could serve another department.
examples.zh: 案例为可以调给另一个部门的机器计算了「调作他用的价值」。

examples.en: We discussed redeployment value before deciding what to include in the cost comparison.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「调作他用的价值」，再决定成本比较纳入哪些项目。

collocations: compare redeployment value with disposal proceeds

words.enDefinition: Production ability not required for the current level of activity

examples.en: The workshop had spare capacity because two printers were free that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，两台打印机还有空，因此工作室尚有「闲置产能」。

examples.en: We checked spare capacity before calculating the extra shift the order might need.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「闲置产能」，再计算订单可能需要新增的班次。

words.enDefinition: Use all available production capacity during the period being considered

examples.en: The case assumed both presses would operate at full capacity before the new order arrived.
examples.zh: 案例假设，新订单到来之前，两台印刷机都将「满负荷运行」。

examples.en: If the machines operate at full capacity, the sample shop would need another shift.
examples.zh: 如果机器已经「满负荷运行」，示例商店就需要再加一个班次。

collocations: continue to operate at full capacity
expect to operate at full capacity
plan to operate at full capacity

words.enDefinition: Capacity already reserved for work the organisation has agreed to perform

examples.en: The production sheet listed committed capacity for orders already promised to local customers.
examples.zh: 生产表把已答应当地顾客的订单对应的「已承诺的产能」列了出来。

examples.en: We deducted committed capacity before offering any machine time to the other team.
examples.zh: 我们先减去「已承诺的产能」，再把机器时间提供给另一个小组。

words.enDefinition: Increasing available output for a limited time to meet demand

examples.en: The case priced a temporary capacity expansion by renting equipment for two weeks.
examples.zh: 案例估算了通过租两周设备来「临时扩大产能」的费用。

examples.en: Our comparison treated temporary capacity expansion separately from committing to a new workshop.
examples.zh: 我们在对比中，把「临时扩大产能」和增设一个新工作室区分开。

collocations: cost of a temporary capacity expansion
compare options for temporary capacity expansion

words.enDefinition: Using one available resource in place of another to perform work

examples.en: The example explored resource substitution by shifting finishing work onto another machine.
examples.zh: 示例通过把收尾工序移到另一台机器上，讨论了「资源替换」。

examples.en: We logged the time changes caused by resource substitution on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表上记录了「资源替换」造成的工时变化。

collocations: assess the cost of resource substitution

words.enDefinition: A consideration such as quality or reliability not directly measured in money

examples.en: The team recorded delivery reliability as a nonfinancial factor in its comparison.
examples.zh: 团队把交货可靠性记录为对比中的一项「非财务因素」。

examples.en: A nonfinancial factor mattered when the two options produced identical cost estimates.
examples.zh: 两种方案的成本估算完全相同时，一项「非财务因素」影响了判断。

words.enDefinition: Deciding whether to accept an order outside normal sales terms

examples.en: Our special order decision compared the extra proceeds with the additional production costs.
examples.zh: 我们的「特殊订单决策」比较了额外收入与新增生产成本。

examples.en: The tutor introduced a special order decision involving a large one-off print run.
examples.zh: 导师用一项大型一次性印刷业务介绍了「特殊订单决策」。

collocations: a special order decision at full capacity
factors in a special order decision

words.enDefinition: The sales proceeds expected from accepting an unusual customer order

examples.en: The special order revenue rose when the buyer requested a larger batch.
examples.zh: 买方要求增大批量时，「特殊订单收入」也增加了。

examples.en: We recorded special order revenue separately from expected sales to regular customers.
examples.zh: 我们把「特殊订单收入」和对常规顾客的预计销售额分开记录。

collocations: compare special order revenue with cost

words.enDefinition: The lowest price covering the additional and opportunity costs of acceptance

examples.en: We checked the minimum special order price after adding a separate delivery cost.
examples.zh: 我们加入单独的配送费后，核对了「特殊订单最低接受价」。

examples.en: The case raised the minimum special order price when serving regular customers became impossible.
examples.zh: 接了订单就无法服务常规顾客时，案例提高了「特殊订单最低接受价」。

collocations: calculate the minimum special order price
compare the minimum special order price with the offer
quote a minimum special order price

words.enDefinition: Normal sales lost when new work uses the same scarce resources

examples.en: The worksheet counted displaced regular sales because the machine had no spare time.
examples.zh: 由于机器没有空余时间，练习表计入了「被挤占的常规销量」。

examples.en: Our case compared displaced regular sales with the volume of the proposed batch.
examples.zh: 案例比较了「被挤占的常规销量」与拟议批次的产量。

words.enDefinition: Extra overtime expense incurred because an alternative adds working hours

examples.en: The rush order added incremental overtime cost because the normal shifts were already full.
examples.zh: 常规班次已经排满，所以加急订单带来了「增量加班成本」。

examples.en: We recalculated incremental overtime cost after the tutor changed the assumed staff hours.
examples.zh: 导师修改了假设工时后，我们重新计算了「增量加班成本」。

collocations: an incremental overtime cost for this batch

words.enDefinition: Expense arising solely because extra work requires another staff shift

examples.en: The forecast added an additional shift cost only in the highest volume case.
examples.zh: 预测只在产量最高的情景下加入了「增开班次成本」。

examples.en: Our class separated additional shift cost from wages for the normal shift.
examples.zh: 全班把「增开班次成本」和常规班次的工资分开了。

collocations: a worksheet with additional shift cost

words.enDefinition: The cost of making a product or component within the organisation

examples.en: The tutor checked which parts of internal production cost would change in the sourcing exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在采购练习中核对了「内部生产成本」的哪些部分会变化。

examples.en: We calculated internal production cost using the same volume as the supplier's quotation.
examples.zh: 我们以和供应商报价相同的数量计算了「内部生产成本」。

collocations: compare internal production cost with a quote

words.zhGloss: 可节省的内部生产成本
words.enDefinition: Internal costs that would stop if work moved to a supplier
acceptedZhAnswers: 可节省的内部生产成本

examples.en: The case listed avoidable in-house costs that would disappear if we outsourced the parts.
examples.zh: 案例列出了外包零件后可以省掉的「内部生产成本」。

examples.en: We compared avoidable in-house costs with the supplier's price and extra delivery expense.
examples.zh: 我们把「可节省的内部生产成本」同供应商报价及额外配送费进行了比较。

collocations: compare avoidable in-house costs with the quote

words.enDefinition: Payment to another business for doing part of contracted work

examples.en: The worksheet added subcontracting cost for the cutting work handled off site.
examples.zh: 练习表计入了在场外完成切割工序的「转包费用」。

examples.en: Our comparison showed subcontracting cost beside the cost of using staff overtime.
examples.zh: 我们的比较把「转包费用」列在员工加班成本旁边。

words.enDefinition: An extra cost of changing from one supplier to another

examples.en: Training the team on new parts created a supplier switching cost in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例里，培训团队使用新零件产生了「更换供应商的成本」。

examples.en: The class included supplier switching cost alongside the new supplier's lower purchase price.
examples.zh: 全班在新供应商较低的采购价旁，也列了「更换供应商的成本」。

collocations: record a one-time supplier switching cost

words.enDefinition: Production capacity no longer needed after work is assigned externally

examples.en: The worksheet estimated capacity freed by outsourcing before considering an alternative batch of work.
examples.zh: 练习表先估算「外包后腾出的产能」，之后才考虑是否改做另一批业务。

examples.en: Our case used capacity freed by outsourcing to make presses available for another product.
examples.zh: 案例通过「外包后腾出的产能」，让印刷机可用于另一款产品。

words.enDefinition: Bring production of a part back inside the organisation

examples.en: The exercise asked whether the workshop could insource a component after adding another machine.
examples.zh: 练习题问，增设一台机器后，工作室能否「将零件改为自制」。

examples.en: We compared the equipment needed to insource a component with the outgoing supplier's cost.
examples.zh: 我们对照了「将零件改为自制」所需的设备费用与原供应商的成本。

words.enDefinition: The activity level at which two alternatives have equal total cost

examples.en: The cost indifference point occurred where the two cost lines crossed on the graph.
examples.zh: 图上两条成本线交叉的位置就是「成本无差别点」。

examples.en: We reported the cost indifference point as the number of units made each month.
examples.zh: 我们用月产量件数表示「成本无差别点」。

collocations: production below the cost indifference point

words.enDefinition: Choosing whether to continue or discontinue an existing line or segment

examples.en: The keep-or-drop decision compared the contribution lost with the costs that would disappear.
examples.zh: 「保留或停办决策」比较了放弃的边际贡献与能节省的成本。

examples.en: Our tutor used a keep-or-drop decision involving a campus stall with falling sales.
examples.zh: 导师用一项销量下滑的校园摊位业务介绍了「保留或停办决策」。

collocations: a keep-or-drop decision for a product line

words.enDefinition: Ending the operations of a business segment or product line

examples.en: The worksheet retained central rent after segment discontinuation in the sample comparison.
examples.zh: 在样本比较里，练习表保留了「停办分部」之后仍要付的总部租金。

examples.en: We discussed which wages might stop as a result of segment discontinuation.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「停办分部」后哪些工资可能不用再付。

words.enDefinition: A part of an organisation showing a loss under the measure used

examples.en: The loss-making segment showed a positive contribution before the central costs were allocated.
examples.zh: 在分摊总部成本之前，这个「亏损分部」仍有正的边际贡献。

examples.en: Our group checked which expenses would actually disappear with a loss-making segment.
examples.zh: 我们组核对了一个「亏损分部」停办后，哪些支出才会消失。

words.enDefinition: Shared costs that continue after a project or segment is dropped

examples.en: The closure scenario listed retained common costs because the lease still covered both units.
examples.zh: 租约仍覆盖两个单位，所以关闭情景列出了「仍需承担的共同成本」。

examples.en: We moved retained common costs out of the savings column on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「仍需承担的共同成本」从练习表中的节省额一栏移了出去。

words.enDefinition: comparing uses of a single scarce resource, commonly by ranking products by contribution per unit of that resource

examples.en: We used limiting factor analysis when the workshop had fewer labour hours than planned.
examples.zh: 工作室可用工时比计划少时，我们用了「限制因素分析」。

examples.en: The limiting factor analysis compared both products using minutes on the same machine.
examples.zh: 「限制因素分析」按两种产品占用同一台机器的分钟数作了比较。

words.expression: contribution per unit of limiting factor
words.lemma: contribution per unit of limiting factor
words.zhGloss: 单位限制资源的边际贡献
words.enDefinition: Contribution margin earned for each unit of a constrained resource used
acceptedZhAnswers: 单位限制资源的边际贡献
acceptedEnVariants: contribution per unit of limiting factor

examples.en: The worksheet ranked products by contribution per unit of limiting factor when labour hours were scarce.
examples.zh: 工时紧张时，练习表按「单位限制资源的边际贡献」给产品排序。

examples.en: We recalculated contribution per unit of limiting factor after the machine time per piece changed.
examples.zh: 单件占用的机器时间变化后，我们重新计算了「单位限制资源的边际贡献」。

collocations: calculate contribution per unit of limiting factor
rank by contribution per unit of limiting factor
compare contribution per unit of limiting factor

words.enDefinition: The production combination giving the best result under stated constraints

examples.en: The optimal product mix used all the printing time available in the example.
examples.zh: 该示例中的「最优产品组合」用完了所有可用打印时间。

examples.en: We calculated another optimal product mix after finding that the maximum demand for posters was lower than expected.
examples.zh: 发现海报需求上限低于预期后，我们重新算了一种「最优产品组合」。

collocations: constraints on the optimal product mix

words.enDefinition: The most that buyers are expected to order during a period

examples.en: The model stopped producing each item once its maximum demand was met.
examples.zh: 每种商品达到「需求量上限」后，模型就停止安排生产。

examples.en: We checked maximum demand before giving the remaining hours to another product.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「需求量上限」，再把剩余工时分给另一款产品。

words.enDefinition: The output or available time at the operation limiting total production

examples.en: The two products shared the same bottleneck capacity on the finishing machine.
examples.zh: 两款产品共用收尾设备这道工序的「瓶颈工序产能」。

examples.en: Cleaning reduced bottleneck capacity by taking time away from the limiting machine.
examples.zh: 清洁占用了瓶颈机器的运行时间，使「瓶颈工序产能」下降。

collocations: make better use of bottleneck capacity

words.enDefinition: Minutes available or required at the operation limiting total output

examples.en: The first product used more bottleneck minutes even though it was smaller.
examples.zh: 第一款产品虽较小，却占用了更多「瓶颈工序分钟数」。

examples.en: We checked the available bottleneck minutes before completing the sample production plan.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了可用的「瓶颈工序分钟数」，再完成示例生产计划。

words.enDefinition: An approach focusing on throughput, operating expense, and constrained capacity

examples.en: The class used throughput accounting to compare two products sharing one machine.
examples.zh: 全班用「产出会计」比较了两种共用一台机器的产品。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced throughput accounting with a case involving limited finishing capacity.
examples.zh: 导师用受收尾工序产能限制的案例引入了「产出会计」。

collocations: compare throughput accounting with traditional costing

words.enDefinition: Sales revenue less direct material cost under conventional throughput accounting

examples.en: The throughput contribution calculation deducted material costs from sales in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中计算「产出贡献」时，从销售收入中扣除了材料成本。

examples.en: We kept labour outside throughput contribution in this particular throughput accounting model.
examples.zh: 在这套产出会计模型里，我们计算「产出贡献」时没有扣人工成本。

words.enDefinition: Throughput contribution divided by each product's time on the constrained resource

examples.en: The return per factory hour was highest for the item yielding the most contribution per milling hour.
examples.zh: 每铣削工时产出贡献最高的商品，具有最高的「单位瓶颈工时产出」。

examples.en: We divided throughput by bottleneck time to find return per factory hour for each product.
examples.zh: 我们用产出贡献除以瓶颈工时，算出各产品的「单位瓶颈工时产出」。

collocations: rank products by return per factory hour

words.zhGloss: 单位瓶颈工时工厂成本
words.enDefinition: Total factory operating costs divided by available hours at the bottleneck
acceptedZhAnswers: 单位瓶颈工时工厂成本

examples.en: The worksheet used total factory operating expense to calculate cost per factory hour in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习表用工厂运营支出总额，计算「单位瓶颈工时工厂成本」。

examples.en: Extra time at the bottleneck changed cost per factory hour in the workshop example.
examples.zh: 工作坊示例中，瓶颈工序增加的时间改变了「单位瓶颈工时工厂成本」。

collocations: compare returns with cost per factory hour

words.enDefinition: Return per constrained factory hour divided by cost per factory hour

examples.en: The throughput accounting ratio changed when the bottleneck moved to a different machine.
examples.zh: 当瓶颈转移到另一台机器时，「产出会计比率」发生了变化。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which product had the higher throughput accounting ratio in the comparison.
examples.zh: 导师问，在比较中哪种产品的「产出会计比率」更高。

words.enDefinition: An approach improving overall performance by managing the most limiting factor

examples.en: The theory of constraints exercise focused first on the machine limiting production.
examples.zh: 「约束理论」练习首先关注那个限制生产的机器。

examples.en: We discussed the theory of constraints after seeing work accumulate before the finishing stage.
examples.zh: 我们看到半成品在收尾工序前堆积后，讨论了「约束理论」。

words.enDefinition: Local change in the objective from one extra unit of capacity

examples.en: The model displayed the shadow price of capacity beside the machine hour limit.
examples.zh: 模型在机器工时限制旁列出了「产能影子价格」。

examples.en: We compared the shadow price of capacity with the quoted cost of another hour.
examples.zh: 我们把「产能影子价格」和再加一小时的报价作了比较。

collocations: estimate the shadow price of capacity
use the shadow price of capacity
a positive shadow price of capacity

words.enDefinition: The financial or operating results of a distinct business division

examples.en: The report measured divisional performance before reviewing how each manager had performed.
examples.zh: 报告先衡量了「分部经营绩效」，再评价每位经理的表现。

examples.en: Our group used two measures of divisional performance for the same period.
examples.zh: 我们组用了两种方法衡量同一期间的「分部经营绩效」。

words.enDefinition: Assessing how effectively a manager handles the decisions they control

examples.en: The managerial performance evaluation excluded a rent change imposed by head office.
examples.zh: 「管理者绩效评价」排除了总部决定的租金变化。

examples.en: We compared managerial performance evaluation with the separate report on the whole unit.
examples.zh: 我们把「管理者绩效评价」和针对整个单位的单独报告作了比较。

collocations: use financial measures in managerial performance evaluation

words.enDefinition: Capital or assets whose use a divisional manager can influence

examples.en: The worksheet excluded head office equipment from the manager's controllable investment.
examples.zh: 练习表把总部设备排除在经理的「可控投资额」之外。

examples.en: The tutor asked which assets belonged in controllable investment for this division.
examples.zh: 导师问，该分部的哪些资产应计入「可控投资额」？

words.enDefinition: Capital used in a division under the chosen performance definition

examples.en: We calculated divisional capital employed using the net assets specified in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们按照练习指明的净资产口径来计算「分部占用资本」。

examples.en: The model used divisional capital employed alongside operating profit for its divisional comparison.
examples.zh: 模型用「分部占用资本」和营业利润来比较分部表现。

collocations: use divisional capital employed as the denominator

words.enDefinition: Fixed costs identifiable with a particular segment, regardless of controllability

examples.en: The unit's dedicated equipment lease was among its traceable fixed costs.
examples.zh: 该单位的专用设备租赁费是其「可追溯的固定成本」之一。

examples.en: We separated traceable fixed costs from expenses that supported both outlets together.
examples.zh: 我们把「可追溯的固定成本」与同时服务两家门店的费用分开了。

words.enDefinition: Fixed expenses supporting several segments that cannot be traced to one

examples.en: The help desk rent was included in common fixed costs for both units.
examples.zh: 服务台租金被列入两个单位的「共同固定成本」。

examples.en: Our report deducted common fixed costs only after displaying each segment's own margin.
examples.zh: 我们的报告先显示各分部自身的利润，再扣除「共同固定成本」。

words.enDefinition: Segment revenue less the variable costs of earning that revenue

examples.en: The segment contribution margin rose when the unit sold more without changing prices.
examples.zh: 该单位价格不变、销量上升后，「分部边际贡献」提高了。

examples.en: We found segment contribution margin before subtracting the unit's traceable fixed costs.
examples.zh: 我们在扣除该单位可追溯的固定成本之前，先计算了「分部边际贡献」。

words.enDefinition: A segment's contribution margin less its own traceable fixed costs

examples.en: The tutor calculated segment margin before deducting expenses shared across all units.
examples.zh: 导师在扣除各单位共同承担的费用前，先算出「分部边际利润」。

examples.en: The worksheet showed a positive segment margin after deducting the equipment lease cost.
examples.zh: 扣除设备租赁费后，练习表上的「分部边际利润」仍为正。

words.enDefinition: An internal statement showing revenue and costs by business segment

examples.en: The segment income statement put the bookshop and print service in separate columns.
examples.zh: 「分部利润表」把书店和打印服务列在不同栏位。

examples.en: We compared two formats for the segment income statement in our class exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中比较了「分部利润表」的两种格式。

collocations: lines on a segment income statement

words.enDefinition: Assigning some centrally incurred expenses to individual operating units

examples.en: The head office cost allocation lowered reported divisional profit in the sample performance table.
examples.zh: 绩效样表里的「总部成本分摊」降低了报告中的分部利润。

examples.en: We checked whether the head office cost allocation changed between the two reporting formats.
examples.zh: 我们核对了两种报告形式下「总部成本分摊」是否变化。

collocations: calculate a head office cost allocation
the basis for head office cost allocation
exclude head office cost allocation from a measure

words.enDefinition: The measure used to apportion shared expenses among participating units

examples.en: The case used floor area as its allocation basis for shared costs for the two units.
examples.zh: 案例用占地面积作为两个单位的「共同成本分摊依据」。

examples.en: We tested a different allocation basis for shared costs and compared the resulting reports.
examples.zh: 我们试用了不同的「共同成本分摊依据」，对比了生成的报告。

collocations: choose an allocation basis for shared costs
change the allocation basis for shared costs
explain an allocation basis for shared costs

words.enDefinition: The average recorded value of assets used in operating activities

examples.en: We calculated average operating assets from the opening and closing figures in the case.
examples.zh: 我们使用案例中的期初和期末数据计算「平均经营资产」。

examples.en: The worksheet listed average operating assets beneath the line for operating profit.
examples.zh: 练习表在营业利润一行下面列了「平均经营资产」。

words.enDefinition: The measured value of operating assets included in a performance calculation

examples.en: The case changed the operating asset base to exclude an unused building.
examples.zh: 案例调整了「经营资产基数」，扣掉了一栋闲置建筑。

examples.en: We compared two versions of the operating asset base in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中比较了「经营资产基数」的两种计算口径。

words.enDefinition: Measuring assets after subtracting recorded depreciation from their recorded cost

examples.en: The worksheet used a net book value basis for both factories' equipment figures.
examples.zh: 练习表里的两个工厂都用「账面净值口径」计算设备数值。

examples.en: We checked how the net book value basis affected a division with older assets.
examples.zh: 我们核对「账面净值口径」怎样影响拥有较旧资产的分部。

collocations: calculate assets on a net book value basis
a return measured on a net book value basis
use a net book value basis

words.enDefinition: Measuring assets at recorded cost before deducting accumulated depreciation

examples.en: The instructor used a gross book value basis for the original equipment figures.
examples.zh: 导师用「账面原值口径」列出了设备最初记录的金额。

examples.en: We applied the gross book value basis before comparing investment across two model divisions.
examples.zh: 我们先采用「账面原值口径」，再比较模型里两个分部的投资。

collocations: use a gross book value basis
calculate assets on a gross book value basis
compare returns on a gross book value basis

words.enDefinition: Division profit remaining after deducting a charge for capital used

examples.en: The exercise reported divisional residual income after applying a charge for using capital.
examples.zh: 练习在扣除资本占用费用后，列出了「分部剩余收益」。

examples.en: We compared divisional residual income under two assumptions about the required return.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两种必要报酬率假设下的「分部剩余收益」。

words.enDefinition: A calculated charge for using capital without requiring a cash payment

examples.en: The model deducted an imputed capital charge before showing residual income for the unit.
examples.zh: 模型计算该单位的剩余收益之前，先扣除一笔「估算的资本占用费」。

examples.en: Our tutor used the same percentage when calculating the imputed capital charge for both units.
examples.zh: 导师按同一个百分比计算两个单位的「估算的资本占用费」。

words.enDefinition: The lowest acceptable percentage return on a defined investment base

examples.en: The tutor set a minimum required return for both divisions in the model.
examples.zh: 导师在模型中给两个分部都设定了「最低必要报酬率」。

examples.en: We multiplied the minimum required return by the asset base in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中，我们把「最低必要报酬率」乘以资产基数。

words.enDefinition: a residual income measure that subtracts a charge for invested capital from after-tax operating profit, with accounting adjustments where applicable

examples.en: The worksheet calculated economic value added after applying the charge for using capital.
examples.zh: 练习表计入资本占用费用后，计算了「经济增加值」。

examples.en: Our class compared economic value added with a simple profit figure for the division.
examples.zh: 全班把「经济增加值」同分部未经进一步调整的利润作了比较。

collocations: a positive economic value added figure
use economic value added to assess a division

words.enDefinition: Alignment between decisions by individual managers and overall organisational objectives

examples.en: The report discussed goal congruence after the divisions chose different sourcing options.
examples.zh: 两个分部选择不同采购方案后，报告讨论了「目标一致性」。

examples.en: We compared two bonus measures and their effect on goal congruence.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两种奖金考核指标及其对「目标一致性」的影响。

words.enDefinition: A division's freedom to make decisions without approval from central managers

examples.en: The case linked divisional autonomy to the freedom to choose outside suppliers.
examples.zh: 案例把「分部自主权」和选择外部供应商的自由联系在一起。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how central approval affected divisional autonomy in the example.
examples.zh: 导师问，案例中总部审批对「分部自主权」有哪些影响？

words.enDefinition: a decision made by a division that gives the organisation a worse result than an available alternative

examples.en: The case showed a suboptimal divisional decision caused by the reporting incentives.
examples.zh: 案例展示了报告考核激励如何导致「损害整体的分部决策」。

examples.en: The class traced a suboptimal divisional decision to the way each unit was rewarded.
examples.zh: 全班发现，这项「损害整体的分部决策」缘于各部门的奖励方式。

collocations: an example of a suboptimal divisional decision

words.enDefinition: A misleading performance figure caused by the way results are measured

examples.en: The old asset values caused a performance measurement distortion in the comparative report.
examples.zh: 旧资产价值造成对照报告中的「绩效衡量失真」。

examples.en: We discussed how shared cost allocations created performance measurement distortion in the sample figures.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了共同成本分摊如何让样本数据产生「绩效衡量失真」。

collocations: an example of performance measurement distortion

words.zhGloss: 以市价为基础的转移价
words.enDefinition: An internal charge based on the price in an outside market
acceptedZhAnswers: 以市价为基础的转移价

examples.en: The model used a market-based transfer price based on independent sales of the same part.
examples.zh: 模型根据同种零件的独立交易，设定了「以市价为基础的转移价」。

examples.en: We checked how a market-based transfer price would change if outside prices fell.
examples.zh: 我们核对了外部价格下跌时，「以市价为基础的转移价」会如何变化。

collocations: compare a market-based transfer price with cost

words.zhGloss: 协商确定的内部转移价
words.enDefinition: An internal charge agreed by the divisions exchanging goods or services
acceptedZhAnswers: 协商确定的内部转移价

examples.en: Both managers signed off on a negotiated transfer price for the next batch.
examples.zh: 两位经理都批准了下一批的「协商确定的内部转移价」。

examples.en: The case compared a negotiated transfer price with the rate stipulated by management.
examples.zh: 案例将「协商确定的内部转移价」与管理层规定的费率作了对照。

collocations: agree on a negotiated transfer price

words.enDefinition: An internal charge set at the transferred item’s variable cost

examples.en: The workbook showed a variable-cost transfer price based on the unit’s material and labour costs.
examples.zh: 练习册列出了按单位材料和人工成本计算的「变动成本内部转移价」。

examples.en: Our group calculated a variable-cost transfer price after the component material price changed.
examples.zh: 零件材料价格变动后，我们组计算了「变动成本内部转移价」。

collocations: compare a variable-cost transfer price with market price

words.enDefinition: An internal charge including variable production costs and allocated fixed costs

examples.en: The example full-cost transfer price included fixed production overhead assigned to each item.
examples.zh: 示例中的「完全成本内部转移价」包括分摊到各件商品的固定生产间接费用。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed a full-cost transfer price next to the original cost figures.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表在原始成本数据旁列出了「完全成本内部转移价」。

collocations: compare a full-cost transfer price with marginal cost

words.enDefinition: An internal charge based on preset costs for goods or services

examples.en: The standard-cost transfer price stayed unchanged when actual production costs rose that month.
examples.zh: 当月实际生产成本上升时，「标准成本内部转移价」仍保持不变。

examples.en: We checked the cost standard behind the standard-cost transfer price in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上查了「标准成本内部转移价」依据的成本标准。

collocations: a standard-cost transfer price for components

words.enDefinition: An internal charge based on the costs actually incurred by production

examples.en: The actual-cost transfer price rose when the supplying unit paid more for materials.
examples.zh: 供应分部多付了材料费之后，「实际成本内部转移价」提高了。

examples.en: Our comparison showed how a delay affected the actual-cost transfer price that month.
examples.zh: 我们的比较显示，延期怎样影响当期的「实际成本内部转移价」。

collocations: compare an actual-cost transfer price with a standard

words.enDefinition: An internal charge calculated by adding a margin to defined cost

examples.en: The worksheet calculated a cost-plus transfer price using the factory's standard cost and markup.
examples.zh: 练习表按照工厂的标准成本和加成数额，计算了「成本加成内部转移价」。

examples.en: The two divisions compared their profit under a cost-plus transfer price in class.
examples.zh: 两家分部在课堂案例里对照了采用「成本加成内部转移价」时各自的利润。

collocations: choose a markup for a cost-plus transfer price

words.enDefinition: Using different amounts for selling and buying divisions in one transfer

examples.en: The case used dual transfer pricing to record different amounts for the two divisions.
examples.zh: 案例用「双重内部转移定价」为两个分部记录不同金额。

examples.en: We discussed how dual transfer pricing required reconciling the two internal figures centrally.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了采用「双重内部转移定价」时，总部如何核对两笔内部金额。

collocations: reconcile balances under dual transfer pricing
an example of dual transfer pricing

words.enDefinition: An internal charge combining a per-unit amount with a fixed fee

examples.en: Our model split the two-part transfer price into a unit charge and monthly fee.
examples.zh: 我们把模型中的「两部制内部转移价」分成每件收费和月度固定费。

examples.en: The instructor compared a two-part transfer price with one charge per unit sold.
examples.zh: 导师把「两部制内部转移价」与单一的按件收费作了比较。

collocations: a fixed fee under a two-part transfer price

words.zhGloss: 最低可接受内部转移价
words.enDefinition: The lowest internal charge acceptable to the supplying division
acceptedZhAnswers: 最低可接受内部转移价

examples.en: The minimum transfer price increased after the transfer would displace some outside sales.
examples.zh: 当内部调拨会挤占部分对外销售时，「最低可接受内部转移价」提高了。

examples.en: Our worksheet calculated a minimum transfer price for the division supplying the components.
examples.zh: 练习表算出了供应零件的分部的「最低可接受内部转移价」。

collocations: compare the minimum transfer price with an offer

words.zhGloss: 最高可接受内部转移价
words.enDefinition: The highest internal charge acceptable to the receiving division
acceptedZhAnswers: 最高可接受内部转移价

examples.en: A cheaper outside offer lowered the maximum transfer price in our classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例里，较低的外部报价降低了「最高可接受内部转移价」。

examples.en: We calculated the maximum transfer price from the receiving unit's available alternatives.
examples.zh: 我们根据接收单位可选的其他方案，计算了「最高可接受内部转移价」。

collocations: a maximum transfer price for the buyer

words.zhGloss: 可协商的内部转移价区间
words.enDefinition: The interval of internal prices acceptable to both divisions
acceptedZhAnswers: 可协商的内部转移价区间

examples.en: The transfer price range narrowed after the outside supplier lowered its offer.
examples.zh: 外部供应商降价后，「可协商的内部转移价区间」缩小了。

examples.en: The worksheet showed no transfer price range because the minimum exceeded the maximum.
examples.zh: 由于最低接受价超过最高接受价，练习表没有显示「可协商的内部转移价区间」。

collocations: negotiate within the transfer price range
find a workable transfer price range

words.enDefinition: The business unit providing goods or services in an internal transfer

examples.en: The selling division recorded revenue even though no customer outside the group paid.
examples.zh: 尽管集团没有收到外部顾客付款，「内部供货分部」仍记录了收入。

examples.en: We checked whether the selling division had enough time to produce both orders.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「内部供货分部」是否有时间生产两笔订单。

collocations: revenue recorded by the selling division

words.enDefinition: The business unit receiving goods or services in an internal transfer

examples.en: The buying division compared the internal charge with the outside quote.
examples.zh: 「内部采购分部」比较了内部收费与外部报价。

examples.en: In the sample accounts, the buying division recorded a component cost.
examples.zh: 在账户样本里，「内部采购分部」记录了一笔零件成本。

collocations: compare options for the buying division
costs recorded by the buying division

words.enDefinition: The price a division can charge customers outside its organisation

examples.en: The external selling price provided a benchmark for the proposed internal charge.
examples.zh: 「对外销售价格」为拟议的内部收费提供了基准。

examples.en: We adjusted the external selling price for delivery costs in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例中，我们在配送成本方面调整了「对外销售价格」。

collocations: use the external selling price as a benchmark

words.enDefinition: The amount an external seller quotes for supplying an item

examples.en: The outside supplier price included packaging that the internal unit could provide itself.
examples.zh: 「外部供应商报价」包括内部单位可自行提供的包装。

examples.en: We checked whether the outside supplier price included delivery to the receiving division.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「外部供应商报价」是否包括往接收分部配送的费用。

collocations: an outside supplier price for the part

words.enDefinition: An external quote for closely matching goods, quantities, and terms

examples.en: We received a comparable market quotation for the same size and quality of part.
examples.zh: 我们收到了一份相同尺寸、相同质量零件的「可比市场报价」。

examples.en: The case had no comparable market quotation for the custom component or its delivery.
examples.zh: 这个案例没有该定制零件及配送服务的「可比市场报价」。

words.zhGloss: 调拨可节省的对外销售费
words.enDefinition: External selling expenses saved when goods are transferred within the organisation
acceptedZhAnswers: 调拨可节省的对外销售费

examples.en: The model deducted avoidable external selling costs before using the market price as a reference.
examples.zh: 模型先扣除「调拨可节省的对外销售费」，再以市场价为参考。

examples.en: The sales commission was among the avoidable external selling costs in our classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例里，销售佣金属于「调拨可节省的对外销售费」。

words.enDefinition: Costs arising only because a particular internal transfer takes place

examples.en: The round trip between sites created transfer-specific costs in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习表里，两处场地往返运输产生了「内部调拨专属成本」。

examples.en: We accounted for transfer-specific costs before comparing the outside quote with internal sourcing.
examples.zh: 我们比较外部报价和内部供货前，先计入了「内部调拨专属成本」。

collocations: add transfer-specific costs to the comparison

words.enDefinition: The number of units moved between parts of an organisation

examples.en: The company increased internal transfer volume when the second unit needed more components.
examples.zh: 第二个单位需要更多零件时，公司增加了「内部调拨量」。

examples.en: We checked what internal transfer volume the supplying department could handle that term.
examples.zh: 我们核对了供货部门该学期能够承担多少「内部调拨量」。

words.enDefinition: Income credited to a division for goods or services transferred internally

examples.en: The worksheet credited internal transfer revenue to the unit producing the components.
examples.zh: 练习表把「内部调拨收入」记入生产零件的单位。

examples.en: We showed internal transfer revenue separately from sales made to external customers.
examples.zh: 我们把「内部调拨收入」与对外部顾客的销售额分开列示。

collocations: remove internal transfer revenue from group profit

words.enDefinition: An amount assigned to a receiving unit for an internal purchase

examples.en: The model increased the internal purchase charge after the transfer price was revised.
examples.zh: 转移价格调整后，模型提高了「内部采购收费」。

examples.en: We matched the internal purchase charge to the components sent by the other unit.
examples.zh: 我们把「内部采购收费」和另一个单位送来的零件对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A market for items serving as inputs to further production

examples.en: The case had an intermediate product market providing a reference price for components.
examples.zh: 案例中存在一个为零件提供参考价的「中间产品市场」。

examples.en: Our lecturer explained why no intermediate product market existed for that customised part.
examples.zh: 老师解释了该定制零件为什么没有「中间产品市场」。

collocations: prices in an intermediate product market
sell in an intermediate product market

words.enDefinition: Extra sales revenue less additional costs other than the acquired input

examples.en: The receiving unit calculated net marginal revenue after subtracting its own finishing costs.
examples.zh: 接收分部扣除自身的收尾加工成本后，计算了「净边际收入」。

examples.en: The model compared net marginal revenue with the proposed charge for the component.
examples.zh: 模型把「净边际收入」与该零件的拟议收费作了对照。

collocations: compare net marginal revenue with a transfer price
net marginal revenue of the receiving division

words.enDefinition: Total contribution after external revenues and relevant variable costs are combined

examples.en: The model calculated company-wide contribution before assigning income to separate operating units.
examples.zh: 模型先算出「全公司边际贡献」，再给各运营单位分配收益。

examples.en: We compared company-wide contribution across sourcing options before looking at divisional results.
examples.zh: 我们先比较不同采购方案的「全公司边际贡献」，再看各分部的结果。

words.enDefinition: The organisation's gain from an internal transfer after relevant costs

examples.en: The case calculated the net benefit of internal transfer using only costs that would actually change.
examples.zh: 案例只用实际会发生变动的成本计算「内部调拨净收益」。

examples.en: Our group checked the net benefit of internal transfer after losing a potential outside sale.
examples.zh: 失去一笔潜在的对外销售后，我们组核对了「内部调拨净收益」。

collocations: calculate the net benefit of internal transfer
compare the net benefit of internal transfer
a positive net benefit of internal transfer

words.enDefinition: A policy requiring units to obtain designated items from within the organisation

examples.en: The memo described mandatory internal sourcing for components available from the group's factory.
examples.zh: 备忘录说，集团工厂能供应的零件实行「强制内部采购」。

examples.en: We discussed how mandatory internal sourcing affected the buyer's ability to compare suppliers.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「强制内部采购」如何影响采购方比较供应商。

words.enDefinition: A division's freedom to choose whether to purchase internally or externally

examples.en: Because the division had sourcing autonomy, it could switch to an outside supplier with better delivery terms.
examples.zh: 事业部拥有「采购来源自主权」，因此可以换成配送条件更好的外部供应商。

examples.en: Our exercise asked whether sourcing autonomy could coexist with a common price rule.
examples.zh: 练习问，「采购来源自主权」是否可以和统一定价规则并存？

words.enDefinition: Rules for setting charges between units of the same organisation

examples.en: The new transfer pricing policy used market quotes when comparable transactions were available.
examples.zh: 有可比交易时，新的「内部转移定价政策」采用市场报价。

examples.en: We checked the transfer pricing policy before evaluating the two units' reported profit.
examples.zh: 我们先查了「内部转移定价政策」，再评价两个单位公布的利润。

words.enDefinition: A disagreement between divisions over the charge for an internal transaction

examples.en: Head office reviewed a transfer pricing dispute over the price of printed covers.
examples.zh: 总部复核了一起印刷封面价格的「内部转移定价争议」。

examples.en: The tutor used a transfer pricing dispute to illustrate competing divisional targets.
examples.zh: 导师用「内部转移定价争议」来说明各分部目标如何发生冲突。

words.enDefinition: A charge assigned to one unit for another unit's service

examples.en: The report applied an internal service charge for equipment repairs completed on site.
examples.zh: 报告对现场完成的设备维修计入了「内部服务收费」。

examples.en: We compared the internal service charge with the fee quoted by an outside technician.
examples.zh: 我们把「内部服务收费」和外部技术人员报的费用作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A movement of goods or services between divisions of one organisation

examples.en: The interdivisional transfer brought enough printed covers to the binding division.
examples.zh: 「分部间调拨」为装订分部运来了足够的印刷封面。

examples.en: The sample form recorded each interdivisional transfer in a separate column.
examples.zh: 样本表格在单独一栏记录了每笔「分部间调拨」。

words.enDefinition: Adjustments removing internal revenues and charges from totals for all divisions

examples.en: The summary used interdivisional eliminations before showing profit for the whole organisation.
examples.zh: 汇总表先计入「分部间交易抵销项」，再显示全组织利润。

examples.en: We matched the interdivisional eliminations to the amounts the two units recorded.
examples.zh: 我们把「分部间交易抵销项」与两个单位记录的金额一一对应。

words.enDefinition: The cost reduction after accounting for relevant expenses of external supply

examples.en: The model showed net savings from outsourcing even after adding the supplier's delivery charge.
examples.zh: 即使加上供货商的配送费，模型也显示存在「外包节省的净成本」。

examples.en: We checked whether net savings from outsourcing changed if employees could switch to other work.
examples.zh: 我们核对了员工若转去做其他工作，「外包节省的净成本」会不会变化。

collocations: review projected net savings from outsourcing

words.enDefinition: Facilities expense that ends when a particular activity or site closes

examples.en: The cancelled storage lease counted as avoidable facility cost in the closure analysis.
examples.zh: 在关闭分析中，取消的仓储租赁费计入「可节省的设施成本」。

examples.en: We calculated avoidable facility cost separately from rent that the business still paid.
examples.zh: 我们把「可节省的设施成本」与企业仍要支付的租金分开计算。

words.enDefinition: The sales level where a segment's margin reaches zero

examples.en: We calculated the segment break-even point using the outlet's traceable fixed costs and its contribution per sale.
examples.zh: 我们用该门店自身的可追溯固定成本和每笔销售的边际贡献计算「分部盈亏平衡点」。

examples.en: Our class calculated the segment break-even point before comparing two proposed sales levels.
examples.zh: 全班先算出「分部盈亏平衡点」，再对比两个拟议的销售水平。

collocations: sales above the segment break-even point

words.enDefinition: A segment's margin expressed as a percentage of its revenue

examples.en: The segment margin percentage helped compare two outlets with very different sales volumes.
examples.zh: 「分部边际利润率」便于比较两家销量相差很大的门店。

examples.en: We put segment margin percentage below the corresponding dollar amounts in the report.
examples.zh: 我们在报告相应的金额下方列出了「分部边际利润率」。

words.enDefinition: Breaking return on investment into its profit margin and asset turnover components

examples.en: The tutor used ROI decomposition to explain which ratio changed between the two periods.
examples.zh: 导师用「投资回报率分解」来说明两个期间之间究竟哪个比率变了。

examples.en: Our ROI decomposition pointed to faster turnover even though profit margin was unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们通过「投资回报率分解」发现，虽然利润率未变，但周转加快了。

words.enDefinition: Controllable profit after a charge on capital the manager controls

examples.en: The controllable residual income calculation excluded equipment controlled by the central office.
examples.zh: 计算「可控剩余收益」时，排除了由总部控制的设备。

examples.en: We compared controllable residual income with the result for all capital used by the division.
examples.zh: 我们把「可控剩余收益」与计入分部全部占用资本后的结果作了对照。

words.zhGloss: 可追溯但不可控的成本
words.enDefinition: A cost attributable to a unit but outside its manager's control
acceptedZhAnswers: 可追溯但不可控的成本

examples.en: The rent set by head office was a traceable but uncontrollable cost for the branch.
examples.zh: 总部规定的房租是门店「可追溯但不可控的成本」。

examples.en: Our worksheet included a traceable but uncontrollable cost when assessing the unit's overall financial performance.
examples.zh: 评估该单位整体财务表现时，练习表计入了一项「可追溯但不可控的成本」。

collocations: identify a traceable but uncontrollable cost
show a traceable but uncontrollable cost
a traceable but uncontrollable cost in the report

words.enDefinition: Moving existing employees to work on other tasks or activities

examples.en: The costing case included labour redeployment after the first production line closed.
examples.zh: 第一条生产线关闭后，成本案例考虑了「人员调配」。

examples.en: Our group assessed labour redeployment before estimating any reduction in payroll spending.
examples.zh: 我们组先研究了「人员调配」，再估算薪资支出能减少多少。

words.enDefinition: An agreement to buy at least a specified quantity or value

examples.en: The outside quote included a minimum purchase commitment that affected the comparison.
examples.zh: 外部报价含「最低采购承诺」，这对方案对比有影响。

examples.en: We estimated inventory needs before evaluating the minimum purchase commitment in the contract.
examples.zh: 评估合同中的「最低采购承诺」前，我们估算了库存需求。

collocations: agree to a minimum purchase commitment
factor in a minimum purchase commitment

words.enDefinition: Extra spending for checks required by a proposed alternative

examples.en: The supplier option had incremental inspection cost because each new shipment needed another check.
examples.zh: 每批新货要额外查验，因此采购方案产生了「增量检验成本」。

examples.en: We calculated incremental inspection cost separately from the ordinary checks already planned.
examples.zh: 我们把「增量检验成本」和原先计划中的常规查验分开计算。

collocations: an incremental inspection cost per shipment

words.enDefinition: A limit on available staff time for carrying out planned work

examples.en: The case added a labour-hour constraint after the weekday shifts were reduced.
examples.zh: 工作日班次减少后，案例加入了「人工工时约束」。

examples.en: We compared three production plans under the same labour-hour constraint in class.
examples.zh: 全班在相同「人工工时约束」下比较了三种生产计划。

words.enDefinition: Paid worker time when no productive task is being performed

examples.en: The trial order used idle labour time without extending the workers' paid shifts.
examples.zh: 试制订单利用了「闲置人工工时」，现有员工的带薪班次没有延长。

examples.en: We recorded idle labour time separately from the extra hours needed on weekends.
examples.zh: 我们把「闲置人工工时」与周末需要新增的工时分开记录。

words.enDefinition: A change to the charge used for an internal transaction

examples.en: The report showed a transfer price adjustment after the agreed component specification changed.
examples.zh: 约定的零件规格改变后，报告列出了「内部转移价调整」。

examples.en: We checked how a transfer price adjustment affected the two divisions' reported margins.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「内部转移价调整」如何影响两个分部报告的利润水平。
